impact.formula: nba/model/players.js: ridge-regularised adjusted plus-minus on reconstructed lineup stints, y = 100 * points / possessions = L_season + h * home + sum(O_offence) - sum(D_defence); weights possessions x exp(-ln2 * age / half_life); prior mean o = d = -0.5; parameters in nba/params/live.json tuning.pass

minutes.measure: ewm_minutes (half-life 8 games, carried across trades) with the preseason prior (nba/injury/core.js nbaExpectedMinutes)
